title: JSON Schema 2020-12 with the validonce rules vocabulary
description: The 2020-12 dialect plus one keyword, x-validonce: cross-field validation rules (rule format v1). The vocabulary is optional, so a validator that does not know it still processes schemas and treats x-validonce as an annotation. Spec: https://github.com/metatoy/validonce/blob/main/docs/rule-format-v1.md
